name: crabhud
description: Above the prompt: a crab that shows what Claude is doing, a progress bar for long jobs (also on its own from Claude's task list or an approved plan), and a HUD with model, effort, context, 5-hour and 7-day limits and cost, in seven bar styles (/crabhud style). Beside it: a live panel of subagents. Ships the /crab-flow skill and its five worker agents.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: pt by default; auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale
